categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of polystyrene high polymer new materials, including GPPS (General Purpose Polystyrene) and HIPS (High Impact Polystyrene). It focuses on high-end, specialized polystyrene products used in electronics, household appliances, optical displays, packaging, construction materials, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymerization technologies with multi-stage reactors and precise temperature and pressure control to produce high-quality polystyrene with low residual monomer content. It has proprietary formulations and patents for specialized GPPS and HIPS products, including high-transparency, anti-yellowing, high-gloss, and low-temperature resistant materials. Continuous R&D efforts focus on improving product performance and developing new grades for emerging applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic household appliance manufacturers such as Midea, Haier, and Changhong, as well as companies in optical display, lighting, medical equipment, and packaging sectors. The company serves primarily the electronics, home appliance, automotive, medical, and consumer goods industries, with a strong presence in high-value, high-technology market segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a strong market presence in the South China (especially Guangdong) and East China regions. It is located in the Huizhou Daya Bay Petrochemical Industrial Zone, benefiting from proximity to major petrochemical suppliers and downstream customers. Export markets are gradually expanding due to increasing product quality and capacity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of polystyrene resins, sourcing raw materials like styrene monomer primarily through long-term contracts and pipeline supply from upstream petrochemical producers such as CNOOC Shell. It supplies processed polymer materials to downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity with the ongoing third-phase project, enhancing product portfolio towards multi-variety, specialized, and high-end polystyrene materials, and increasing R&D investment to improve product quality and develop new applications. R&D focuses on low processing temperature GPPS, high-gloss and high-impact HIPS, optical-grade materials, flame-retardant foamed polystyrene, and low-temperature resistant HIPS. Talent acquisition and retention are emphasized to support innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of polystyrene resin products (GPPS and HIPS) to industrial customers and distributors. The company sells physical products rather than services, with sales conducted via direct factory customers and trade merchants. Pricing is influenced by raw material costs and product grade.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the second largest polystyrene producer in South China and aims to become the largest in the region and second nationwide after the completion of its third-phase expansion. It competes on product quality, specialized formulations, and scale. Competitors include domestic and foreign polystyrene manufacturers, with a market trend of intense competition in low-end products and scarcity in high-end specialized grades.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.21 billion, an 11.67% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 53.24 million, a slight decline of 4.57%. The company’s total assets were around RMB 1.89 billion. It maintains steady growth with increasing production capacity and expanding market share, supported by strong cash flow from operations and investment activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality with superior physical properties such as high transparency, low residual monomer, high impact resistance, and specialized formulations tailored to customer needs. Its proximity to raw material suppliers and advanced production technology provide cost advantages and supply stability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and patent portfolio enable it to offer differentiated, high-value-added polystyrene products that meet stringent industry standards and support downstream customers’ product performance requirements.
